## Mongosync

- [MongoDB Mongosync - (current)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongosync/current/llms.txt.md): > Mongosync is a cluster-to-cluster synchronization utility for migrating data between self-managed MongoDB deployments and MongoDB Atlas.
